invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to Clozer
invitation.body: You'll join the “{workspace}” workspace: your proposals, who reads them, and when to follow up.
invitation.footer: Link valid for 7 days. Not expecting this? Ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Clozer
welcome.title: Just one thing to do
welcome.body: Drop in a document (quote, invoice, deck, anything), then open the link the way your prospect would. You'll see right away what Clozer shows you. Two minutes.
welcome.noInstall: Nothing to install, it all happens in your browser.

noDocument.subject: Your first document on Clozer
noDocument.title: Take the last document you sent
noDocument.body: Even an old one. Drop it into Clozer and open the link: you'll see exactly what your prospect will see, and what you'll learn from their read.
noDocument.example: No document at hand? An example is waiting for you.

notSent.subject: Your link is ready, it hasn't gone out yet
notSent.title: Your link is waiting for its prospect
notSent.body: Paste it into your next email, instead of the attachment. As soon as your prospect opens it, you'll know.

firstRead.subject: {label} opened your document
firstRead.body: Your first link was read. On the prospect's page: the pages read, the time spent, and what Clozer makes of it.
firstRead.followup: If a follow-up would help, Clozer writes it for you. It waits in “Follow-ups to review”, nothing goes out without you.
firstRead.extension: For next time: in Gmail or Outlook, the Clozer Chrome extension puts the link in place of the attachment, no copy-paste.

outlookConnected.subject: Outlook connected to your Clozer account
outlookConnected.intro: An Outlook was just connected to your Clozer account ({when}).
outlookConnected.ifYou: If that was you, nothing to do.
outlookConnected.otherwise: Otherwise, revoke it right away in Settings › Chrome and Outlook: {url}
outlookConnected.otherwiseHtml: Otherwise, revoke it right away in Settings › Chrome and Outlook.

billing.afterFree: After that, your workspace moves to the Free plan: your links keep working and you keep all your data. Free means 5 new links a month, 10 AI follow-ups, no prospect assistant and no team view.

trialEnding.subject: {days, plural, one {Your Team trial ends tomorrow} other {Your Team trial ends in # days}}
trialEnding.title: Your trial ends on {date}
trialEnding.body: You've had everything in Clozer during your trial. To keep it, pick Solo (19 € a month) or Team (39 € per member).
trialEnding.offer: Your 30% discount for 12 months is valid until the end of the trial. If you pick a plan now, you only pay from that date, except in the last two days, when billing starts right away.

trialEnded.subject: Your Clozer trial is over
trialEnded.title: You're on the Free plan now
trialEnded.body: Your Team trial just ended. Nothing was deleted, and you can move to Solo or Team whenever you like.

betaNotice.subject: Clozer is leaving beta
betaNotice.title: Paid plans start on {date}
betaNotice.body: Thanks for using Clozer during the beta. As promised, you hear it first: paid plans start on {date}. Until then your workspace stays on Team, for free.
betaNotice.prices: Solo is 19 € a month (15 € billed yearly), Team 39 € per member (32 € billed yearly). Prices excl. VAT.

betaEnding.subject: Your free beta access ends on {date}
betaEnding.title: One week left on the beta
betaEnding.body: Your workspace stays on Team until {date}. Pick a plan before then if you want to keep everything.

paymentFailed.subject: Your Clozer payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.title: Your card was declined
paymentFailed.body: Stripe will try again over the next few days. Update your card to keep your plan, it takes a minute.

subject.auth_revoked: Your mailbox {mailbox} needs to be reconnected
subject.policy_bounces: Your campaigns are paused: too many rejected emails

intro.auth_revoked: Access to {mailbox} was revoked or expired, so sending is stopped until you reconnect it.
intro.policy_bounces: {mailbox} got several rejections from recipients' servers today. Your active campaigns are paused so your reputation isn't hurt further. Resume them once you've checked the list.
intro.send_failed: Several emails from {mailbox} could not be sent. The affected contacts are paused.
intro.sync_failed: Clozer could not check {mailbox} for replies. Replies may show up late until this is fixed.
